title: Markers, likelihood, stacks
preconditions: Open `map.html` on **Specific Map**. For likelihood colour, use early/mid March and check **Grevy's Zebra** (Africa Savanna).
dateUnderTest: Record the Specific Map date used.

steps.name: Pick mixed-likelihood date
steps.do: Set Specific Map to early/mid March (before late April, when **Grevy's Zebra** is already near peak).

steps.name: Likelihood colour
steps.do: Find **Grevy's Zebra**, note its icon colour (low likelihood leans dark red; high leans dark green), then switch to a peak-summer Specific Map date and compare the same marker.
steps.expect: On early/mid March the icon is toward dark red / orange; on peak summer it is toward dark green.

steps.name: Find stack or skip
steps.do: Look for a stacked/count marker at shared coordinates.
steps.expect: If none in seed: **Blocked** — stacking covered when shared coords exist; continue other steps.

steps.name: Carousel UI
steps.do: Confirm multiple items are listed or carouseled.
steps.expect: More than one entity is represented.

steps.name: Advance carousel
steps.do: Use next/prev on the carousel if present.

steps.name: Amenity styling spot-check
steps.do: Enable **Restaurants** or **Gift Shops** or **Attractions**; spot-check open/closed or likelihood styling.
steps.expect: Markers render with expected open/closed or likelihood treatment.

steps.name: Limited-viewing / alert badge
steps.do: If seed has limited viewing or alerts, find `marker-has-limited-viewing` / badge styling.
steps.expect: Badge visible if data exists; else **Blocked** → CON-02/CON-03.

steps.name: Zoom stability
steps.expect: Markers stay anchored; not orphaned off-map incorrectly.

steps.name: Return to Specific Map
steps.do: Leave a mid-season Specific Map date selected.
